import requests, numpy as np, pandas as pd, matplotlib.pyplot as plt
from matplotlib.patches import Rectangle

seqs={}
for iso in ["Q86UX2-1","Q86UX2-2","Q86UX2-3","Q86UX2-4"]:
    seqs[iso]="".join(requests.get(f"https://rest.uniprot.org/uniprotkb/{iso}.fasta",timeout=60).text.strip().split("\n")[1:])
KD=dict(A=1.8,R=-4.5,N=-3.5,D=-3.5,C=2.5,Q=-3.5,E=-3.5,G=-0.4,H=-3.2,I=4.5,L=3.8,K=-3.9,M=1.9,
        F=2.8,P=-1.6,S=-0.8,T=-0.7,W=-0.9,Y=-1.3,V=4.2)
def kd(s,w=9):
    v=[KD[a] for a in s]
    return np.array([np.mean(v[max(0,i-w//2):i+w//2+1]) for i in range(len(v))])

# canonical-coordinate spans of each isoform
spans={"isoform 1 (942 aa)":[(1,942)],
       "isoform 2 (694 aa)":[(1,666),("alt",667,694)],
       "isoform 3 (728 aa)":[("alt",215,218),(219,942)],
       "isoform 4 (244 aa)":[("alt",450,473),(474,677),("alt",678,693)]}
SP=(1,16); VIT=(35,161); VWFA=(295,478)

fig=plt.figure(figsize=(15,9))
gs=fig.add_gridspec(3,4,height_ratios=[1.25,1.0,1.0],hspace=0.55,wspace=0.3)

# ---- Panel A: architecture ----
axA=fig.add_subplot(gs[0,:])
ylab=[];
for i,(name,parts) in enumerate(spans.items()):
    y=len(spans)-i
    ylab.append((y,name))
    for p in parts:
        if p[0]=="alt":
            axA.add_patch(Rectangle((p[1],y-0.18),p[2]-p[1]+1,0.36,fc="#d69e2e",ec="k",lw=0.5))
        else:
            axA.add_patch(Rectangle((p[0],y-0.18),p[1]-p[0]+1,0.36,fc="#cbd5e0",ec="k",lw=0.5))
    covered=set()
    for p in parts:
        a,b=(p[1],p[2]) if p[0]=="alt" else p
        covered|=set(range(a,b+1))
    for (ds,de),col,lab in [(SP,"#c53030","signal peptide"),(VIT,"#2f855a","VIT"),(VWFA,"#2b6cb0","VWFA")]:
        if all(x in covered for x in range(ds,de+1)) and not any(p[0]=="alt" and p[1]<=ds<=p[2] for p in parts):
            axA.add_patch(Rectangle((ds,y-0.18),de-ds+1,0.36,fc=col,ec="k",lw=0.5))
    phob = "Phobius SP: YES" if i<2 else "Phobius SP: none, TM: none"
    axA.text(960,y,phob,va="center",fontsize=9,color="#c53030" if i<2 else "#1a202c")
axA.set_xlim(-20,1230); axA.set_ylim(0.3,4.7)
axA.set_yticks([y for y,_ in ylab]); axA.set_yticklabels([n for _,n in ylab],fontsize=10)
axA.set_xlabel("position in canonical ITIH5 (Q86UX2-1) numbering")
for c,l in [("#c53030","signal peptide 1-16"),("#2f855a","VIT 35-161"),("#2b6cb0","VWFA 295-478"),
            ("#d69e2e","isoform-specific alternative exon"),("#cbd5e0","shared canonical sequence")]:
    axA.plot([],[],"s",color=c,label=l)
axA.legend(loc="lower right",fontsize=8,ncol=2)
axA.set_title("A  ITIH5 isoform architecture: isoforms 3 and 4 start downstream of the signal peptide",fontsize=11,loc="left")

# ---- Panel B: N-terminal hydropathy ----
for k,(iso,s) in enumerate(seqs.items()):
    ax=fig.add_subplot(gs[1,k]); p=kd(s[:60])
    ax.plot(range(1,61),p,color="#2b6cb0",lw=1.6)
    ax.axhline(1.6,color="#c53030",ls="--",lw=0.9)
    ax.fill_between(range(1,61),1.6,p,where=(p>1.6),color="#c53030",alpha=0.3)
    ax.set_ylim(-3.5,4); ax.set_title(f"{iso}\nmax KD = {p.max():.2f}",fontsize=9)
    ax.set_xlabel("residue",fontsize=8)
    if k==0: ax.set_ylabel("Kyte-Doolittle (w=9)",fontsize=8)
fig.text(0.013,0.455,"B  N-terminal 60-residue hydropathy. Dashed line: 1.6, typical h-region floor",fontsize=11)

# ---- Panel C: conservation ----
cons=pd.DataFrame([
 dict(region="canonical exon 1 CDS\n(signal peptide)",phylop=0.521,alignable=23,nonprim=11),
 dict(region="isoform 3\nalt first exon",phylop=-0.327,alignable=19,nonprim=0),
 dict(region="isoform 4\nalt first exon",phylop=-0.169,alignable=31,nonprim=10),
 dict(region="shared internal exon\n(control)",phylop=3.406,alignable=70,nonprim=46)])
axC1=fig.add_subplot(gs[2,:2])
axC1.bar(cons.region,cons.phylop,color=["#c53030","#d69e2e","#d69e2e","#2f855a"])
axC1.axhline(0,color="k",lw=0.6); axC1.set_ylabel("mean phyloP100way")
axC1.tick_params(axis="x",labelsize=8)
axC1.set_title("C  Base-level conservation (hg38)",fontsize=11,loc="left")
axC2=fig.add_subplot(gs[2,2:])
x=np.arange(len(cons))
axC2.bar(x-0.2,cons.alignable,0.4,label="all mammals aligned",color="#4a5568")
axC2.bar(x+0.2,cons.nonprim,0.4,label="non-primate mammals",color="#d69e2e")
axC2.set_xticks(x); axC2.set_xticklabels(cons.region,fontsize=8)
axC2.set_ylabel("species with aligned sequence"); axC2.legend(fontsize=8)
axC2.set_title("D  Ensembl EPO mammals alignment coverage",fontsize=11,loc="left")
plt.suptitle("ITIH5 isoforms 3 and 4 have no predicted route into the secretory pathway; their alternative first exons are not conserved outside primates",
             fontsize=12.5,y=0.985)
plt.show()

tab=pd.DataFrame([
 dict(isoform="Q86UX2-1",length=942,N_terminus="MLLLLGLCLGLSLCVGS",canonical_start=1,Phobius_SP="Y (n2-13 c17/18)",Phobius_TM=0,maxKD_1_40=3.42,domains="SP+VIT+VWFA+C-term"),
 dict(isoform="Q86UX2-2",length=694,N_terminus="MLLLLGLCLGLSLCVGS",canonical_start=1,Phobius_SP="Y (n2-13 c17/18)",Phobius_TM=0,maxKD_1_40=3.42,domains="SP+VIT+VWFA, C-term replaced"),
 dict(isoform="Q86UX2-3",length=728,N_terminus="MRNYDSGPPPSTVINQ",canonical_start=215,Phobius_SP="none",Phobius_TM=0,maxKD_1_40=1.74,domains="VWFA+C-term, no SP, no VIT"),
 dict(isoform="Q86UX2-4",length=244,N_terminus="MRTYDTPGTSMCIIPD",canonical_start=450,Phobius_SP="none",Phobius_TM=0,maxKD_1_40=1.64,domains="no SP, no VIT, VWFA truncated"),
])
print(tab.to_string(index=False))
tab.to_csv("/agent/jobs/751146a9-dc23-49c8-ac3a-da13249e67c2/provenance/itih5_isoform_targeting_table.csv",index=False)
cons.to_csv("/agent/jobs/751146a9-dc23-49c8-ac3a-da13249e67c2/provenance/itih5_altexon_conservation.csv",index=False)
print("\nsaved provenance tables")
